steps: Peel and slice 2 bananas into thin rounds; set aside half for topping.
Mash the remaining banana slices in a large bowl until smooth.
Add coconut milk, vanilla, maple syrup, and cinnamon to the mashed banana.
Whisk until evenly combined and no lumps remain.
Stir in chia seeds and mix well to distribute them throughout the mixture.
Pour into 4 individual cups or jars, dividing evenly.
Top each cup with the reserved banana slices.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until fully set and pudding-like.
Serve cold. Keeps covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
